notes: #9 (Ludwigskirche and St. Jakob over the rooftops) is a strong scene, but it comes from a Saar-Hilfswerk postcard series and its ‘about 1900’ date is doubtful (probably 1920s–30s), so it was skipped. #12 (1967) looks over the Saar from a height but its subject is a new office building; skipped as weak. #3 (1804) depicts the French before the city in 1793, painted afterward. #6 (about 1750) is a small, low-resolution prospect. #11 and #16 are street scenes; #19 (2011) is a hazy view with bare trees.
